title: Tenth Station: Jesus is Stripped of His Garments
text:
Consider the rage in which His executioners stripped Him of His clothes. His inner garments adhered to His torn flesh, and when they took the clothing off, the skin came with them. Soothe your Savior thus cruelly treated, and say to Him:

My innocent Jesus, by the merits of the pain and grief Thou
hast felt, help me to strip myself of all affection to things of
earth, in order that I may place all my love in Thee, who art
so worthy of my love.
I love Thee, my Jesus; I love Thee more than myself; I am sorry
for having offended Thee. Never let me stray from Thee again.
Grant that I may always love Thee and do Thy will. Amen.
notes: Text as distributed in the 'Catholic Prayers' Android app (richarddean.angeles.catholicprayers).
